purpose: Analyze the 14 unresolved container-intro-only outcomes and prepare deterministic resolution batches without rereading source files or changing any review decision.

current-title-window-recovery.diagnosis: Candidate source pages existed, but the line-window matcher could not reconstruct the current canonical title.
current-title-window-recovery.recommended_method: Test normalized token windows, punctuation-insensitive joins, and multi-line title reconstruction against locally held private evidence.

non-contents-occurrence-recovery.diagnosis: The only selected occurrence resembled a table-of-contents entry rather than the canonical source opening.
non-contents-occurrence-recovery.recommended_method: Use canonical structure-map locators and a page-range search beyond the contents section to recover a non-contents occurrence.

successor-anchor-recovery.diagnosis: The current title was selected, but the canonical successor title was not found inside the bounded six-page search window.
successor-anchor-recovery.recommended_method: Generate successor-title variants from canonical metadata and test a wider anchor-only search without classifying prose or changing decisions.
